-- USAGE:
-- drop table if exists #PopulateForwardLineageReturn; -- create table #PopulateForwardLineageReturn ( -- IntersectID int not null, -- PredicateId int not null, -- PredicateUid uniqueidentifier null, -- PredicateName nvarchar(max) null, -- PredicateType int null, -- SubjectHop int not null, -- SubjectId bigint not null, -- ObjectHop int not null, -- ObjectID bigint not null -- ) -- exec graph.PopulateForwardLineage @currentHop = @currentHop, @endHop = @endForwardHop, @assetIds = @hopAssetIds, @intersectIds = @hopIntersectIds
create or alter procedure graph.PopulateForwardLineage ( @currentHop int, @endHop int, @assetIds dbo.Ids readonly, @intersectIds dbo.Ids readonly ) as begin insert into #PopulateForwardLineageReturn select I.IntersectID, I.PredicateID, I.PredicateUid, I.PredicateName, I.PredicateType, @currentHop as SubjectHop, H.ID as SubjectID, @currentHop+1 as ObjectHop, O.ID as ObjectID from @assetIds H inner join Asset S on S.ID = H.Id inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.SubjectAssetID = S.ID and I.PredicateType in (1, 12, 13) inner join Asset O on O.ID = I.ObjectAssetID
while @currentHop < @endHop begin insert into #PopulateForwardLineageReturn select I.IntersectID, I.PredicateID, I.PredicateUid, I.PredicateName, I.PredicateType, f.ObjectHop as SubjectHop, f.ObjectID as SubjectID, f.ObjectHop+1 as ObjectHop, O.ID as ObjectID from #PopulateForwardLineageReturn f inner join Asset S on S.ID = f.ObjectID inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.SubjectAssetID = S.ID and I.PredicateType in (1, 12, 13) and I.IntersectID <> f.IntersectID and I.IntersectID not in (select Id from @intersectIds) inner join Asset O on O.ID = I.ObjectAssetID where f.ObjectHop = @currentHop + 1
set @currentHop = @currentHop + 1 end end
